_why: Skill-candidates row `hmad-dispatch probe <agent>` (2026-09-05): `read agy` sat on a spinner for 20+ minutes while `env` already showed the right answer, and a hand-rolled probe matched a transposed literal that would have filed a live agent dead. The verb derives question and answer from one pair of operands, matches a whole token, and keeps 'listing unreadable' apart from 'no answer'. Each row breaks one of those.

mutations.name: expected-drifts-from-the-question
mutations._mechanism: The expected answer is computed apart from the question (here off by one), the transposed-literal defect: a live agent answering correctly is never matched.

mutations.name: substring-match-calls-a-wrong-answer-alive
mutations._mechanism: Without the digit boundary, `3409970` matches `340997`, so a wrong answer reads as ALIVE.

mutations.name: unreadable-is-filed-as-dead
mutations._mechanism: A listing that never answered is reported NO_ANSWER, so an unmeasured agent is filed as dead.

mutations.name: operands-are-fixed
mutations._mechanism: A fixed question lets a stale `last=` from an earlier probe read as a fresh answer.
